title: Evangelion: Death (True)² & Rebirth, The End Of Evangelion Films Hit U.S. Theaters for 30th Anniversary Movie Fest on July 21-22
content: GKIDS announced on Thursday that it will host the EVANGELION 30th Movie Fest and screen the films Neon Genesis Evangelion: Death & Rebirth ( Evangelion : Death (True)² & Rebirth ) and The End of Evangelion on July 21 and 22. Tickets for the film are now on sale on GKIDS ' website .
